reuse.why: Adds the check to the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked precondition that all six provider link handlers already call before touching anything, and follows the existing error-constant pattern.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule and its message are defined once.

placement.why: Correct layer (the shared link precondition run before any write), though a guard named for link uniqueness now also carries an unrelated closed-account rule.

scope.why: Only the guard, an error constant and one focused test.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers every provider, but the guard's name no longer describes all it enforces, which a maintainer may trip on.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked: the closed-target refusal is added once in the shared precondition invoked by every *-accounts-link handler (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking, fintegra).
